summary: Sourced 2026 city reports centre on Kanwar-season jams and a disputed smart-road sewer job, with the district hospital and cane dues as wider district-level complaints.

round2.changes: Opened and checked every original URL. Removed Amar Ujala 4 Aug 2026 (Chhutmalpur, about 25 km north of the city, outside the Nagar Palika) and Amar Ujala 21 Mar 2025 (Hindon bridge, AC not confirmed). Removed the 'crowding the markets' claim from Patrika 2018 because the page says no such thing. Replaced Hindon/Chhutmalpur positive with a sourced city wood-carving item (Aaj Tak 6 Aug 2026). Added sourced city items: Amar Ujala 23 Jul 2026 smart-road sewer dispute, Amar Ujala 3 Aug 2026 Kanwar jam Ghantaghar to Sofia Market, Amar Ujala 4 Aug 2025 Smart City Rs 381 crore announcement, and a 2025 Vidhan Parishad reply on the medical college CT scan. Negatives 4 and 5 (2021 and 2018 sources) are flagged inference because persistence in 2024-26 was not shown. Sugar-dues item and Delhi-road item kept as inference with their sources as background. Hindi lines shortened to 13 words or fewer.

positives.english: The government medical college has run a CT scan since June 2024
positives.hindi: मेडिकल कॉलेज में सीटी स्कैन चालू है, जांच हो रही है
positives.basis: UP Vidhan Parishad reply (2025 session, question on Saharanpur district): CT scan at the government medical college (Shaikh-ul-Hind Maulana Mahmood Hasan) installed 25.06.2024; ICU, PICU, digital X-ray and 24x7 blood bank listed as available. District-level; the college's Ambala Road/Beedpur location is not confirmed inside Nagar AC.

positives.english: Wood-carving work keeps many families going in Khatakhedi and nearby areas
positives.hindi: लकड़ी के काम से खाताखेड़ी में रोज़ी-रोटी चलती है
positives.basis: Aaj Tak, 6 Aug 2026 (Saharanpur correspondent): wooden craft trade centres on Khatakhedi and nearby areas; ODOP loans of Rs 87.75 crore to 506 people over nine years; district industry department cites about 350 exporting units and turnover around Rs 1,000 crore; the craft is the livelihood of thousands of families.

positives.english: Smart City: 15 projects worth Rs 381 crore announced for inauguration
positives.hindi: स्मार्ट सिटी के 15 काम, 381 करोड़ के, लोकार्पण की घोषणा हुई
positives.basis: Amar Ujala, 4 Aug 2025: Chief Minister to inaugurate 15 Smart City projects worth Rs 381 crore during his Saharanpur visit. The article announces the inauguration; it does not list the projects or confirm they are complete.

positives.english: *Mills that crush on time mean cane money reaches farm families
positives.hindi: *मिलें समय पर चलें तो गन्ने का पैसा घर तक आता है
positives.basis: Inference: no 2024-26 Saharanpur report of on-time crushing was found; cane payment is a recurring district complaint (see negative 4). District-level.

positives.english: *Highway widening should ease travel through the city
positives.hindi: *हाईवे चौड़ा हो रहा है, शहर से गुजरने में आसानी होगी
positives.basis: Inference: Patrika (19 Apr 2018) says the Delhi-Saharanpur road widening and roadside power-line shifting were planned through the city; no 2024-26 Saharanpur city report of progress or completion was found. Loni (Ghaziabad) widening items are outside this AC.

negatives.english: Government hospital doctors charge for surgery and medicines come from outside
negatives.hindi: अस्पताल में ऑपरेशन के पैसे लगते हैं, दवा बाहर से लानी पड़ती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video (22 Jan 2025): Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tomar) protest at the Chief Medical Officer's office in Saharanpur alleged illegal recovery in the name of surgery at the district hospital and medicines ordered from outside. These are the union's allegations as reported. District-level; the hospital's location inside Nagar AC is not confirmed.

negatives.english: Kanwar diversions jam Ghantaghar to Sofia Market in the city
negatives.hindi: कांवड़ रूट पर घंटाघर से सोफिया मार्केट तक जाम लगा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala, 3 Aug 2026 (photo caption): jam from Sofia Market to Ghantaghar in Saharanpur during the second-phase Kanwar route diversion (midnight 4 Aug to midnight 11 Aug 2026). City-level and seasonal, caused by the diversion.

negatives.english: Sewer work on the under-construction smart road is in dispute among officials
negatives.hindi: निर्माणाधीन स्मार्ट सड़क के सीवर काम पर अफसरों में विवाद
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala, 23 Jul 2026: the Municipal Commissioner sought an explanation for extra sewer work on the under-construction CM Grid phase-2 smart road in Saharanpur, questioned the Jalkal department's earlier advice, and ordered faster work. No ward is named; city-level.

negatives.english: *Sugar mills still owe cane dues and farmers keep waiting for payment
negatives.hindi: *चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया, किसान भुगतान का इंतजार करते हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Jun 2021): district mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, but Rs 630 crore cane price arrears were still pending. No 2025-26 Saharanpur district dues report was found, so persistence is unverified. District-level, dated.

negatives.english: *Delhi highway runs through the city centre because there is no ring road
negatives.hindi: *शहर के बीच से दिल्ली हाईवे निकलता है, रिंग रोड नहीं
negatives.basis: Inference: Patrika (19 Apr 2018) says the Delhi-Saharanpur highway passes through the middle of the city because Saharanpur has no ring road; Court Road and the Hasanpur Chowk-Ghantaghar stretch are named as the main market area. Dated; no 2024-26 source confirms it persists. The page does not describe crowding or jams, so no such claim is made.

notes: Identity: Wikipedia list confirms AC 3 Saharanpur Nagar, district Saharanpur, reserved None. The Saharanpur Nagar AC Wikipedia page defines its area as the Saharanpur Nagar Palika and names no villages or wards; the Saharanpur Dehat AC page returned HTTP 404, so AC 4's boundary was not directly checked. Places treated as inside AC 3 are city locations (Ghantaghar, Sofia Market, Court Road, Hasanpur Chowk, Khatakhedi, Mandi Samiti Road, smart road). Not inside AC 3 on the evidence: Chhutmalpur (Wikipedia: a separate town about 25 km north of Saharanpur, not in the Nagar Palika). Not confirmed: Hindon bridge on the Saharanpur-Dehradun road (police station unnamed), district hospital address, Shaikh-ul-Hind medical college (Ambala Road/Beedpur, coordinates appear west of the city; probably outside Nagar Palika). Dhamola river: only a historical reference found, no modern source, not used. Patrika 2018 page shows a 12 Oct 2026 date banner, which is the page-capture date; the article is from 19 Apr 2018. Negatives 4 and 5 are dated and flagged inference; the sugar-dues and ring-road problems were not shown to persist. Not used: Newstrack encroachment drive (HTTP 403 earlier), undated Amar Ujala drain-cleaning and parking items, Loni/Ghaziabad highway items, Bareilly and Shamli mill items. Field-check priorities: Ghantaghar and Court Road congestion outside Kanwar season, the smart-road sewer work status, the medical college's location against the Nagar Palika boundary, the Dhamola river condition and waterlogging, the district hospital's address, and cane dues for the 2025-26 season.
